defects.what: Rust is one uniform blotchy band at the same height on every side, reads as a texture stripe not water-line rust
defects.fix: Vary rust per side, run it as streaks down from the rim ribs and the lid seam, keep the base clean in places

defects.what: Straight vertical seam line stops dead at the rib with no weld bead
defects.fix: Add a raised weld bead through the ribs or remove the seam

defects.what: Lid is washed-out flat pink and much lighter than the body, plain untextured
defects.fix: Paint it the body colour with rust rings round the bungs and dents

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads clearly as a rusty oil drum; DIESEL stencil legible; looks a bit clean and smooth.

defects.what: Lowest rail is attached at one post only; the other end lies on or hovers just above the ground, so it reads as floating/unsupported
defects.fix: Either rest the free end on the ground with a visible dent and broken end, or fix both ends to the posts

defects.what: Round rails just poke through round posts with no notch, nail or wire; rails overshoot past the posts by 20-30 cm for no reason
defects.fix: Cut rails flush at the post, add notches or spikes and nail heads

defects.what: Only two posts over 4.75 m, smooth tube rails with no knots or cracks; very sparse
defects.fix: Add a middle post, split ends, knots, bark loss

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a rail fence but sparse and skeletal; the dangling lower rail looks like a mistake.

defects.what: Log ends are visibly 7-8 sided facets with the same swirl end-grain texture on every log
defects.fix: Use 12+ sided logs with varied rings, splits and cut angles, randomise the end texture rotation

defects.what: Corrugated sheet bows up in the middle and touches nothing but the two end posts; no rafters or purlins and the sheet sits well above the pile
defects.fix: Add a ridge beam and rafters across the posts and flatten or slope the sheet onto them with nails

defects.what: The two roof weights are identical dark lumps with the same swirl pattern, and the rust patches at both corners mirror each other
defects.fix: Use two different stones or logs and asymmetric rust

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a woodpile under tin; the faceted log ends are the giveaway.

defects.what: Brand-new, no wear, scuffs or grime for a found object in an abandoned site
defects.fix: Add tarnish on the brass caps and dust on the ceramic body

defects.what: Red stripe along the body reads as a seam
defects.fix: Wrap it into a band or move it under the label

defects.what: Tabs are flat plates with plain holes
defects.fix: Add a rolled lip

assets.read_at_game_distance: At 24 cm it is a small tube with brass ends; too small to judge detail from the sheet.

defects.where: audit: 4 floating groups at y=1.25 m, centres (-0.5,+-0.12) and (-0.1,+-0.12); tiles 2,3,4 top cover bolts
defects.what: Bolt heads hover with no contact with the top cover, so the automatic gate fails
defects.fix: Sink the bolts 2 mm into the cover plate or lower them to the plate surface (y of cover top)

defects.where: tile 1 and 6, black box and tank
defects.what: Large dark box sits on the tank with a hard flat plain face, intersects the exhaust pipe and has no seam, vent or bolts
defects.fix: Give it panels, bolts, a vent and a clear mount, move the pipe clear

defects.what: Tank has the same short horizontal dash decals repeated (and a cross in tile 5); radiator fins in tile 3 are a uniform stripe pattern
defects.fix: Replace dashes with real weld seams and a data plate, vary fin damage

defects.what: The rain cap is a thin flat plate floating on a bent pipe
defects.fix: Add a hinge and a visible weld

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as an old air compressor, not a generator; silhouette convincing but the large dark slab looks like a block.

defects.what: Posts are plain smooth grey boxes with no bolts, spacer blocks or washers, and are tinted lighter than the rail; rail seems to rest on top of them
defects.fix: Add offset blocks, bolt heads, slotted holes, and make the posts darker with soil staining

defects.what: Rail reads as round tube rather than a W-beam profile
defects.fix: Model the W corrugation with two humps and a lap seam

defects.what: Rust is one speckle band along the lower edge, uniformly repeated for the whole 8 m, and the top is nearly clean
defects.fix: Rust at bolts and the post contacts, vary along the length

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a guardrail but flat; posts look like blocks.

defects.what: Rail ramps down to a thin knife-edge point that disappears into the ground with no end terminal or buried anchor
defects.fix: Add a flared end terminal plate and anchor post, or cut the rail off at a visible edge above ground

defects.what: Last short post stands beside the sloped rail, not under it; the rail is unsupported along the ramp
defects.fix: Add a post under the ramp midpoint and bolt it

defects.what: Post blocks are plain boxes and the rust band is repeated from the straight section
defects.fix: Same as guardrail: bolts, blocks, varied rust

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a guardrail end, but the ramp vanishing into the ground looks wrong.

defects.what: Mirror of the left end: rail ramps to a point in the ground with no terminal
defects.fix: Add a flared end terminal and anchor

defects.what: End posts are tiny stubs beside the ramp, nothing under it
defects.fix: Place a taller post under the ramp and bolt it

defects.what: Posts are plain boxes with no blocks or bolts
defects.fix: Add hardware

assets.read_at_game_distance: Same as the left end; the mirror shows identical rust, which looks cloned next to its twin.

defects.what: Close-up tile is entirely black, no close view was reviewed (missing render)
defects.fix: Re-render the close-up of the door and window so it can be judged

defects.what: Same dark grime gradient band at the same height on every wall, and the block grid is identical on every wall
defects.fix: Vary grime with splashes by the downpipe, vary block tone and add some cracks and chipped corners

defects.what: Interior is an empty black box, the door slab is thin flat green, and the step slab is a loose tilted plate
defects.fix: Add a frame, hinges, a lock plate and set the step flush; give a hint of interior

defects.what: Roof is a plain concrete plate with a single vent
defects.fix: Add tar patches, drain, stains

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a concrete block utility hut; sensible but blank and clean.

defects.what: Black gap/void between the front panel and the body corner, the panel looks like a separate sheet laid on the can
defects.fix: Make the side wall one continuous shell with rolled seams, no air gap

defects.what: Faces read as soft green cloth/tarp with wrinkles and a painted X, not stamped steel
defects.fix: Use crisp pressed X ribs with a crisp metal sheen, scratches and paint chips

defects.what: Same rust smear along the bottom of both faces
defects.fix: Stagger the rust, add streaks from the seams

defects.what: Three loop handles look like pipe bars with a rod through them; cap handle arbitrary rust-orange
defects.fix: One stamped handle cutout and a strap on the cap

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a green can but the shell looks like fabric and the corner gap shows.

defects.where: audit: 8 floating logs (lowest 0.45-0.97 m) in the three piles
defects.what: Upper logs sit above lower logs with no contact (floating gate fails); also this is a 15x20 m scene, not a prop
defects.fix: Drop each upper log until it touches the two lower logs and re-run the contact check

defects.what: Roof sheets sit at differing pitches with a gap between the panels where sky and a beam show, and corner overhangs stick out with nothing under them
defects.fix: Lay the sheets overlapping on common rafters at one pitch and add purlins

defects.where: tile 3 and 1 shed wall and log ends
defects.what: Wall is one flat plain plank slab and log ends are flat grey with no rings; bark texture identical on all logs
defects.fix: Plank gaps, nails, stain variation; ring texture and splits on the log ends; vary bark

defects.what: Piles are held only by one post per end with a wire
defects.fix: Four stakes per pile

assets.read_at_game_distance: Reads as a timber yard with piles and a shed, but the composition is huge and the roof looks broken.

defects.what: A tiny part hovers at 6 m (lowest 5.98) with no contact, gate fails
defects.fix: Attach it to the nearest rail or post, or delete it

defects.what: Every bay has the same X brace pattern and the same stair flights repeat; braces overlap the stair at flight crossings (tile 6)
defects.fix: Vary spacing and break some braces, route the stairs clear of the braces

defects.what: Cabin and roof read as dark slabs at this scale, so windows, glass and posts can't be checked; roof is dark in tiles 1-4 but pale in tile 5
defects.fix: Re-render a close-up of the cabin; confirm the roof is held by corner posts and the window frames have no gaps

defects.what: Concrete footings plain blocks, no anchor bolts or plates
defects.fix: Add base plates and bolts

assets.read_at_game_distance: Strong silhouette that reads at range as a fire tower; cabin detail unverifiable from the sheet.
